$note: ADOPTED 2026-10-03 (issue #37, DECISIONS log). The player-facing keyword vocabulary: each keyword projects one or more engine tags (CARD_TAGS, derived into tags.json) onto one glyph + one reminder line. Every tag must belong to exactly one keyword (the cards test enforces it). `glyph` names an SVG in art/glyphs; while a glyph is unshipped the client falls back to `abbr`. `terms` are the words RulesText bolds in card text.

keywords.label: Damage
keywords.reminder: Deals damage to your opponent. Wards soak it first; what gets through hits HP.

keywords.label: Burn
keywords.reminder: Burn markers each deal 1 damage at the start of the burned wizard's turn.

keywords.label: Ward
keywords.reminder: A Ward absorbs damage before it reaches your HP and breaks when its HP runs out.

keywords.label: Unravel
keywords.reminder: Damages, halves or destroys the opponent's Wards or ongoing effects.

keywords.label: Prophecy
keywords.reminder: Inscribes a doom that fires at the start of the opponent's turn once its fuse runs out. A Ward that soaks it shatters afterward.

keywords.label: Seal
keywords.reminder: A sealed prepared spell cannot be cast until the seal lifts.

keywords.label: Cancel
keywords.reminder: Stops a spell on the stack from resolving, or turns it back on its caster.

keywords.label: Prevent
keywords.reminder: Reduces or blocks incoming damage, or makes something immune to Reactions. Prevented damage is banked in your ledger.

keywords.label: Draw
keywords.reminder: Draws from your Resource Deck.

keywords.label: Discard
keywords.reminder: You discard from your own hand.

keywords.label: Cost
keywords.reminder: Costs you something extra: your own HP, one of your Wards, or a card for your opponent.

keywords.label: Disrupt
keywords.reminder: Strips, bounces or discards the opponent's components or cards.

keywords.label: Recover
keywords.reminder: Returns cards from the discard, or recasts a spell that was already cast.

keywords.label: Scry
keywords.reminder: Looks at, reorders or searches your Resource Deck.

keywords.label: Reveal
terms: look at the components in your opponent's hand
keywords.reminder: Shows you the opponent's hand.

keywords.label: Lock
keywords.reminder: Restricts or taxes the opponent's casts, Reactions or draws.

keywords.label: Empower
keywords.reminder: More spell damage, an extra cast or attach, or a component trick.

keywords.label: Heal
keywords.reminder: Restores your HP or removes your own Burn.

keywords.label: Ledger
keywords.reminder: Reads or spends the damage you have prevented this match.

keywords.label: Trap
keywords.reminder: Fires on its own when its trigger happens while this Reaction is prepared and fueled.
